title: Appropriate Fabric component selection per workload with documented rationale
ask_for: Component-selection / design-rationale doc (Lakehouse for Bronze/Silver, Warehouse for Gold, DB for Metadata)

rubric.0: No document, or no component choices described
rubric.3: Components mapped to workloads with a written rationale per choice

title: Each medallion layer has a clearly defined purpose and transformation responsibility

rubric.3: Purpose plus transformation responsibility per layer

title: Bronze immutability strategy defined and matches layer responsibility
ask_for: Bronze / ingestion strategy doc (append/raw-capture vs overwrite)

rubric.3: States the strategy and why it matches Bronze responsibility

title: Metadata DB role clearly defined and separated from business data
ask_for: Metadata-DB design doc (run tracking, source changes, control/config/watermarks, lineage)

rubric.3: Full role plus explicit separation from business data

title: Source change capability documented per source
ask_for: Source-capability / CDC design doc (which sources expose I/U/D, which require derivation)

rubric.3: I/U/D plus derivation approach per source

title: Update, delete and merge-conflict strategies documented
ask_for: Load / merge strategy doc (full-replace vs changed-columns; soft/hard/tombstone delete; merge-conflict rule)

rubric.3: Update, delete and merge-conflict all documented per table

title: Metadata schema is documented and version-controlled
ask_for: Metadata schema doc (and a note/link to source control)

title: Warehouse capacity/scale considerations documented
ask_for: Warehouse sizing / scale doc (concurrency, query patterns)

rubric.3: Concurrency and query patterns with a capacity rationale

title: Metadata DB schema is documented
ask_for: Metadata-DB schema doc (run tracking, source changes, control/config/watermark/mapping, lineage)

title: Retention policy defined for audit and metadata history
ask_for: Retention policy doc for audit + metadata history

title: Data quality framework formally defined with DQ KPIs
ask_for: DQ framework doc (rules, ownership, scoring; KPIs: completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, uniqueness, validity)

rubric.2: Rules plus ownership and scoring method
rubric.3: Rules, ownership, scoring and the six DQ KPIs defined

title: DQ remediation workflow exists (alert to investigate to fix to verify)

rubric.3: All four stages (alert, investigate, fix, verify) defined

title: DQ data contracts defined between producer and consumer teams per domain
DQ SLAs defined per data product / Gold table

rubric.3: SLAs per Gold table with targets

title: Retention of historical data and audit-log retention per policy
ask_for: Retention / compliance policy doc (historical financial data + audit-log retention)

rubric.3: Both with durations tied to policy/compliance

title: Data stewards assigned per domain

rubric.3: Every domain (Finance, Sales, etc.) has a steward

title: Ownership documented (roles, not just the team that built it)

rubric.3: Owner, steward and accountable roles named

title: Escalation path for data quality issues defined

rubric.3: Tiered path with owners and response expectation

title: Data dictionary / glossary exists for Gold Warehouse tables
ask_for: Data dictionary / glossary for Gold Warehouse tables

title: Metadata accessible to data consumers (self-service discovery)
The solution's own Metadata DB is documented and discoverable
Common/shared terminology consistent across domains (single business glossary)

rubric.3: Single glossary used consistently across domains

title: Cross-domain data sharing rules defined
Conformed dimensions governed centrally (single owner)
Cross-domain reports have a documented ownership and certification model
Domain boundaries and interfaces (contracts) are documented
Manual intervention procedures documented for non-recoverable failures
Escalation matrix defined (Level 1 to Level 2 to management)

rubric.3: L1 to L2 to management with triggers

title: Fabric SKU selected based on workload analysis (not guesswork)

rubric.3: Analysis plus justification for the SKU

title: Growth projections modeled for next 6-12 months

rubric.3: Volume, workspaces and domains over 6-12 months

title: CU smoothing behavior understood (background vs interactive)

rubric.3: Smoothing explained and applied to planning

title: Lifecycle / purge policies for aged raw files and audit history
Reserved capacity vs. pay-as-you-go evaluated
Architecture overview document exists
Data flow documentation covers all source-to-target mappings
Business rules for transformations documented outside of code
Known issues and tech debt registered

title: Runbook exists for daily/weekly/monthly operations
ask_for: Operations runbook covering daily, weekly and monthly tasks

rubric.0: No runbook, or no recurring operations described
rubric.1: Covers ad-hoc tasks or one cadence only
rubric.2: Daily and weekly routines documented with owners
rubric.3: Daily, weekly and monthly routines, each with owner and steps

title: Failure recovery procedures documented step-by-step
On-call / escalation procedures documented
Capacity scaling procedures documented
Source-to-target mapping documented per table
Acronyms and business terminology glossary available
